sermon.title: A Fruitful Christian—October 20, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Purge the leaven of wickedness. God promises the remnant fruit: the seed of the word, abiding in the Vine, patient pruning and the dew of heaven. Lift the gates of old barriers so rivers of living water can flow.
